label: allow
evidence: In addition, we may retain records to prevent fraud and ensure security
Until you request deletion of the data or delete your account, whichever is earlier.
reason: Statement 1 is introduced with "In addition" as extra retention of records for fraud and security beyond the stated per-feature retention periods, so it reads as an exception to deletion on request.

label: allow
evidence: We will only use your payment data to complete your transaction
share your payment data with banks and other third party financial institutions to process your payment transactions
reason: Sharing payment data with banks to process the payment is part of completing the transaction. The adjacent sentences describe one payment flow, so the sharing falls within the permitted use.

label: deny
evidence: We never seek, store or retain credit card numbers of users
we collect your payment details
reason: Statement 1 covers payment details in general. Statement 2 carves out credit card numbers, which are never sought, stored or retained even when payment details are collected.

label: misread
evidence: If you are a California resident, you have the right to:
Opt out of sales of personal information.
reason: Statement 1 lists a California right to opt out of sales. It does not say the company sells personal information, so it grants no permission to sell.

label: unresolved
evidence: to provide ads or offers personalized for you
Progressive does not share with nonaffiliates so they can market to you
reason: In-app SDK partners may use collected data to provide personalized ads or offers, but the text does not say whose ads. Whether this is sharing so nonaffiliates can market is left vague.

label: misread
evidence: While it is not our intention to collect any personally identifiable information
the data collected may include PII
reason: Statement 2 states an intention and admits that collected data may include PII. It does not prohibit collecting social network data that the user chooses to grant.

label: allow
evidence: We use payment processors
We do not store nor process any Personal Data when you process the payment.
reason: Statement 2 itself relies on payment processors and says only that the company does not store or process payment data. Stripe or PayPal processing the transaction is consistent with that.

label: contradiction
evidence: Personal Information includes your geographic location information
we may not use your Personal Information in any way
reason: Location is defined as Personal Information. Statement 1 says the Applications use, store and combine it with other Personal Information, while statement 2 says Personal Information is not used at all. Nothing reconciles them.

label: unresolved
evidence: We cannot view it unless you expressly give us permission or it’s necessary to comply with our legal obligations
(c) prevent fraud or abuse of ColorNote or its users
reason: Statement 1 allows disclosing Data for fraud, safety or property reasons beyond legal obligations. Statement 2 limits viewing Data. The text does not say whether such disclosures override the viewing limit.

label: unresolved
evidence: We will never share or sell your email address, or any other information collected, to any third parties.
In such transactions user information may be shared with the transmitted part of the company.
reason: Campaign data could be transferred in a restructuring. The text does not say whether the transmitted part of the company is a third party or which statement governs.

label: allow
evidence: Under no circumstance do we share personal information for any commercial or marketing purpose unrelated to the activation and delivery of Nest Products and services without asking you first
For legal reasons: We will share personal information with third parties
reason: The permission pledge targets sharing for welcome additional services, and the sharing section narrows it to commercial or marketing purposes. Legal-reasons sharing is listed among the limited situations allowed.

label: allow
evidence: send marketing communications via SMS
register on the list of opposition to telephone canvassing
reason: The policy lists SMS marketing as a use and then excludes telemarketing, tied to the telephone canvassing opposition list. Telemarketing here means phone canvassing, so SMS marketing is permitted.

label: deny
evidence: We do not collect, process or disclose sensitive personal information for the purpose of inferring characteristics about you
conducting personalized advertising
reason: Statement 2 carves sensitive personal information out of the general sharing in statement 1. Sensitive data may not be disclosed to ad providers for audience building or personalized ads that infer characteristics.

label: deny
evidence: PLOS will collect, store and use your demographic information in accordance with this privacy policy
We will use that information only for internal diversity tracking purposes.
reason: Statement 1's section defers use of demographic data to the policy, and the use section limits it to internal diversity tracking. Analytic uses outside diversity tracking are therefore excluded.

label: contradiction
evidence: We do not collect Personal Information.
Personal Information includes your geographic location information
reason: The same paragraph says no Personal Information is collected, defines location as Personal Information, and then says the Applications use and store location and combine it with other Personal Information.

label: contradiction
evidence: We do not share your data in any other way.
Poki will only share a pseudonymized account ID if the developer has warranted
reason: Statement 2 limits sharing to companies helping Poki with a service. Statement 1 shares pseudonymized account IDs with game developers, which is another kind of sharing. Nothing says which governs.

reason: Locating contacts in games is a use beyond sending invitations, but it may be part of the invitation feature. The text does not clarify which use of contact data is allowed.

reason: The disclosure table lists sensitive personal information, including geolocation and health information, with purposes such as improving marketing and advertising. Statement 2 says SPI is used only to show nearby stores.

label: contradiction
evidence: Use of the on-site search function and the specific terms searched for
We do not use website search terms to build a profile of you by name
reason: Lead scoring combines search terms with CRM data about you to score a named contact and is called profiling. Statement 2 says search terms are not used to build a named profile.

label: unresolved
evidence: so that we can properly update, analyze, and expand our Services

reason: Partner data is provided to maintain functionality. Combining it to analyze and expand services may exceed that reason, but the specific reason is vaguely defined and the text does not settle it.
